note: Declared geometry sources. Every field here is either an assertion ABOUT a source or a hash OVER its bytes; nothing measured from the data itself is written here. docs/geo/sources.md is the search that produced it and the evidence for each classification. `mandate geography fetch` refuses a file whose sha256 does not match.

projection.note: One projection for the whole product, shared with ops/geo/build-india.mjs so the national basemap, district outlines and constituency polygons land in one coordinate space. Equirectangular, scaled at the 22N parallel: anything fancier buys nothing at this size and costs a dependency.

datasets.title: India — Assembly Constituencies

upstream.note: The publisher's README: "Scraped from ECI's Polling Station Locations Website." Corroborated by India_AC.shp.xml (sha256 c77d6749…): ArcGIS, created 2014-11-24, layer AS_Poly, from file://\\EGPDDA\D$\Dev_Documents\ArcGIS\Default.gdb, GCS_WGS_1984.

epochVintage.note: WHEN each polygon's boundaries were in force. The epoch resolver takes the latest epoch the registry contests whose effective_from is on or before this date, which is a question with one answer instead of a threshold. Features the publisher marks pre-delimitation are the boundaries in force the day before DPACO 2008; everything else is the set in force when the shapefile was authored.

jurisdictions.note: Only where the source's own spelling does not normalise to a registry jurisdiction name, or where one source key covers several jurisdictions. Everything else resolves by name.

caveats: The publisher declares that Jammu And Kashmir, Jharkhand, Assam, Manipur, Nagaland and Arunachal Pradesh 'appear to be pre-delimitation boundaries', and carries that per feature in STATUS. The epoch resolver reads the field, not the sentence.
The publisher declares 'there is some shift in the data'. Hence a containment check against an independent administrative dataset.
The publisher declares that some constituency names are incorrect or missing. Hence a name is never the only key.
Telangana's seats are still marked as Andhra Pradesh's, so ANDHRA PRADESH offers two candidate jurisdictions and the match decides per seat.

34 features carry AC_NO 0 and no name — unassigned slivers, Kachchh salt flats, Mumbai islets, two large areas of Jammu & Kashmir outside the 87 seats, and Sikkim's four districts. UNUSABLE: dropped, and counted in the report.

datasets.title: India — Parliamentary Constituencies, 2014

upstream.note: Same repository and, per its README, the same origin as the assembly set. Published under the repository's default CC BY 4.0 rather than the assembly folder's CC BY 2.5 IN.

epochVintage.note: The 2014 Lok Sabha's constituencies, so the boundaries in force on polling day. This is what keeps the set off Assam's delim-2023-as and Jammu & Kashmir's delim-2022-jk: both orders take effect after this date, so neither can be selected.

jurisdictions.note: ST_NAME here is a two-letter code, which matches most registry ids already. These are the ones that do not.

caveats: Telangana is absent: its 17 seats are inside AP's 42, in the undivided numbering.
JK holds 7, which is Jammu & Kashmir's 6 plus Ladakh — a separate jurisdiction in this registry.
The set is the 2014 Lok Sabha's constituencies. It is therefore not Assam's delim-2023-as geometry and not Jammu & Kashmir's delim-2022-jk geometry, and must not be attached to either.

rejected.candidate: Election Commission of India — delimitation orders (DPACO 2008)
rejected.why: Defines each constituency by naming the tehsils, revenue circles and municipal wards it contains. 45,693 text operators and 2 image objects in 639 pages. Deriving polygons needs the 2008 boundaries of every one of those units, which the Commission does not publish.

rejected.candidate: Election Commission of India — Assam final notification 2023, J&K final notification 2022
rejected.why: Raster scans: 210 and 20 image objects, 0 text operators. These are the two epochs a current map most needs and the two whose only published form cannot be turned into polygons deterministically. Georeferencing a scan by eye is the unreliable extraction the brief names as a stop condition.
Administrative geometry, not electoral. A constituency is not an administrative unit. Also unreachable from this environment.
No declared upstream, no licence, no declared defects. Existing is not provenance.
